proc0 · Nov 28, 2026

If strong types are needed it's probably better to remove layers from the abstraction layer and go back down to a systems language and then build for Web (with WASM). Web APIs have matured substantially so more can be built with less code removing need for so much type checking, which agian if needed it's probably better to remove the abstraction layers instead of adding more of them.

I'm just saying JS isn't the best of foundations for types to begin with so building an abstraction layer on top of types, on top of JS, is wild.
